name: 🚨Suspect

Welcome to a game where your only goal is to SURVIVE or KILL! 7 Survivors are completing tasks while avoiding 1 hidden Killer, trying to stay alive. If a body is found, vote to expose the Killer, get it wrong, and the Killer will win and claim the Reward! Inspired by a game where killer is among us 👀
